headline.text: L3 Truffle Line ran with damaged wire-mesh belts on bottomer and enrober before *overnight repair* — metal shavings possible in product stream.

summary: Two active holds resolved within window: L1 S2 buffer-tank chocolate cleared after allergen investigation, L3 ML1 lot-code error sorted and released. Truffle Line mesh-belt damage flagged as foreign-material risk; belts replaced overnight. Two traceability gaps at L2 (missing FW part, unlabeled almond pallets) under investigation.

holds.title: Buffer tank AD5 chocolate—suspected nut allergen cross-contact
holds.summary: Valve stuck open caused overflow; initially held pending nut allergen disposition, then cleared after maintenance confirmed feed-valve design prevents enrober (nut) chocolate from entering non-nut buffer.
holds.status: Resolved—chocolate confirmed clean (melting tank source), hold lifted after investigation.

holds.title: ML1 lot-code mismatch—60 lbs super-sack product
holds.summary: Operators changed lot code before super-sack swap; top 60 lbs removed, sorted, and re-inspected before release.
holds.status: Resolved—sorted product released at 01:44, line resumed production.

food_safety.title: Truffle Line wire-mesh belts torn—bottomer & enrober
food_safety.summary: Mesh belts on bottomer (16:45) and enrober (22:08) found torn and gap widening during production; line ran until 21:40 before shutdown for overnight replacement—metal shavings or wire fragments possible in product.
food_safety.status: Open—belts replaced by 01:00, ATP passed; production resumed 03:20. Recommend hold/inspection of product from 16:45–21:40 window.

food_safety.title: ML4 caramel buildup in vibration platform 3
food_safety.summary: Hardened caramel found between depositor 3 and cooling cabinet 3 during mold removal; platform unable to open initially—foreign material risk if pieces broke loose.
food_safety.status: Resolved—area cleaned, no loose pieces detected in product stream.

quality.title: ML2 flow-wrap machine part missing
quality.summary: Part missing since start of first shift 11:43; operators forgot to post, now lost—traceability gap on what product may have run without the part in place.
quality.status: Open—investigation ongoing, IMS inventory check requested.

quality.title: Almond pallets without labels/traceability
quality.summary: Multiple pallets received from L1 without LP labels; no traceability to lot or source—Quality flagged for scrap disposition pending cycle count.
quality.status: Open—cycle count in progress, unlabeled pallets held for scrap.

sanitation.title: ML1 Cavanna receiving area dirty at shift start
sanitation.summary: First-shift operator received Cavanna with vacuum and area beneath chain dirty; cleaning standard not met during overnight changeover.

opportunities.text: Reinforce shadow-board discipline on ML2 flow-wrap—missing part went unreported for full shift, delaying investigation and creating traceability gap.
Institute receiving verification for almond pallets—today's unlabeled pallets from L1 created scrap event and cycle-count burden that could have been caught at dock.
Consider adding cleaning-roller blade inspection to ML4 startup checklist—today's caramel buildup in vibration platform 3 suggests gap in pre-shift visual checks for stuck product.
Review Truffle Line mesh-belt inspection frequency—both bottomer and enrober belts failed within 5 hours, suggesting wear not caught during pre-shift or CIL checks.
